title: Read embedded StockItem fields and promoted methods on Reservation

steps.expect: Reservation shows the embedded StockItem name and its own fields. Type closure brings SKU, OnHand, and Reserved. StockItem.Available's blast includes the promoted call inside Reservation.Hold. Do not require a file-level import edge from reservation.go to stock.go.

expected.residual: stock.go and reservation.go are the same Go package and have no import statements. A missing file-level imports edge is an expected residual, not a failure. Missing embedded fields or Available is a failure.
